runs.question: Which four functions make up the NIST AI RMF Core, and which one is described as cross-cutting?

answer.text:
The NIST AI RMF Core has four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. As illustrated in Figure 5, the Core is composed of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. GOVERN is the one described as cross-cutting. The framework says it is designed to be a cross-cutting function to inform and be infused throughout the other three functions.

The framework also notes that GOVERN has a different scope from the others: while GOVERN applies to all stages of organizations' AI risk management processes and procedures, the MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions can be applied in AI system-specific contexts and at specific stages of the AI lifecycle.
